chapters.content:
GOUT 323

Radium brom. (tds) : It is a very useful remedy in chronic rheumatic
arthritis. Severe pain in all the limbs and joints,
knees, ankles, shoulders, arms, hands, fingers,
toes, calves, hip joints, etc. all have pains which
are worse at night, open air, touch, cold air
and movements.
Ranunculus bulb. (tds) : Rheumatic and muscular pains along the lower
margin of shoulder blade. Pain like pleurodynia
in chest. Worse in spring.
Rhamnus cal. Q (qid) : A positive remedy for muscular pains and
rheumatism. 10 drops a dose, four times a day.
It is indicated when there is constipation also.
Rhododendron ch. (tds) : Pains are wandering, now in this joint and then
in that joint. Arthritic nodes. Pains are worse
before thunderstorm and in hot season. Gout
of toe joints.
Rhus tox. 200 (tds) : Gout worse in damp and rainy weather. Pain
increases from rising from a sitting position or
on first motion and becomes better by walking
for sometime and increases again on taking a
long walk. Rheumatism due to suppression of
perspiration. Pain in nape of neck and lions.
Tearing pain in tendons, ligaments and face.
Ruta (tds) : Pain in the tendons appearing after their injury.
Pain due to a bruise in the lining of the bones.
Pain is better by movement and is worse in
damp, cold weather and during rest.
Sabina (tds) : Arthritic pain in joints. Gout due to urinary
troubles worse in a heated room and on motion.
Sanguinaria (tds) : Pain in the right shoulder and arm worse from
the heat of the bed. Pain on raising the arm.
Solanum lyc. (tds) : Dull pain in the lumbar region. Sharp pain in
the right deltoid and breast muscle. Pain in the
right elbow, wrist and in both hands and legs.
Stellaria m. Q (bd), : Chronic rheumatic pains.
Aurum mur. nat. 3x (tds),
Carbonium sulph. (tds),
China off. (tds)
324 GOUT—GROIN

Syphilinum 1000 (hs) : Rheumatism of the shoulder joint at the
intersection of deltoid. Muscles become hard,
knotty or lumpy and contracted to form knots.
Thyreoidinum (od) : Rheumatic arthritis with tendency to obesity.
Swelling of legs and other parts of body and
cramps.
Tongo 3x (tds) : Severe pain in hips joints, femur and knees,
specially the left.
Tuberculinum 1M (hs) : When the origin is tubercular. Acute
rheumatism of the bones of joints.
Inflammation of joints. Worse motion,
standing, dampness and early in the morning
after sleep. Better open air.
Urtica urens Q (tds) : Rheumatism associated with urticaria-like
eruptions or rheumatism alternates with such
eruptions. Pain in wrists and ankles, worse
during snow and moist air.
Vanadium 6 (tds) : In absence of definite symptoms, the use of
this remedy in chronic rheumatism produces
good results.
NOTE 1: Rheumatoid arthritis occurs when the immune system attacks joints
causing severe inflammation, pain and stiffness. Other types of
arthritis occur in elderly people and is caused by wear and tear of
aging.
NOTE 2: Tennis elbow (epicondylitis) as the name applies is a pain localized at
the level of the elbow. It affects the tendon called epicondylics which
is attached to the elbow. It affects players of tennis, badminton or
any game where the elbow is overused. Treatment is according to
the symptoms.

GROIN
(INGUINAL REGION)

Bellis per. (tds) : Sore and bruised feeling in the pelvic region.
Bad effects of injuries to the pelvic organs and
deeper tissues.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Stitching pain in the groins with urinary
GROIN—GUILT—GUMS 325

troubles or menstrual complaints - worse
motion and standing.
Calcarea carb. 200 (od) : When Rhus tox. ceases to work and the pain is
worse in cold damp weather and better by
movements.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : Soreness in the joint, in bones of sacrum and
illium, as if broken. Symptoms are worse with
any change in weather.
Dulcamara (tds) : Pain in the groins.
Kalium nit. (tds) : Burning pain in the groins during menstruation
only, worse while bending. Menses black,
preceded with severe backache.
Mercurius iod. fl. 2x (tds) : Swollen inguinal glands, large and hard.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Burning pain in the groins during menstruation.
Podophyllum (tds) : Pain in the right inguinal region shoots from
the inner thighs to knees, worse early morning.
Rhus tox. (tds) : Tearing pain in the groins due to exposure to
damp, wet winds or due to lifting of heavy
weights. Swelling of inguinal glands.

GUILT
(SEE ‘DEPRESSION’)

Thuja occ. (tds), : Hidden feeling of guilt and depression thereof.
Arsenicum alb. (tds),
Natrium sulph. (tds),
Staphysagria (tds)

GUMS

GINGIVITIS (INFLAMMED GUMS)

Ammonium carb. (tds) : Gums recede from the teeth and the teeth
become loose.
326 GUMS

Argentum nit. (tds) : Tenderness and bleeding from the gums.
Inflammation of the gums.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Teeth separate from gums. Pain from hot or
cold drinks and their application.
Causticum (tds) : Gums bleed easily.
Hypericum 3x (tds) : Gum pains from extraction of teeth. Soothes
gum pain.
Kreosotum (tds) : Spongy and bleeding gums.
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Bloody saliva with swelling of gums but teeth
are intact.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : Sensative to hot or cold. Gums swollen.
Offensive breath and excessive saliva in the
mouth. Fresh air and fasting relieves. Bleeding.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Gums bleed with a taste of pus in the mouth
and are sensitive to both hot and cold. There
may be ulcers on the gums and in the mouth.
Podophyllum (tds) : Pressing of the gums together in children, with
diarrhea.
GUM BOIL

Aconitum nap. (tds) : Early stage of gum boil with throbbing pain.
Belladonna (qid) : If three hourly four doses of Aconitum do not
relieve the pain, give this remedy.
Inflammatory redness and swelling of the
gums. It will often arrest an incipient gum boil.
Borax 3x (tds) : Painful gum boils.
Calcarea fluor. 6x (tds) : Its use cures the gum boils when there is a hard
swelling on the jaw.
Carbo animalis (tds) : Bleeding; painful and burning gum boils.

Hekla lava 3x (tds) : For painful gum boils and abscess of gums.

Mercurius sol. (tds) : Bright redness of the gum boil. Excessive fetid
saliva. Inflammation of the gums.
Rhus g. Q : It can be applied locally to soft, spongy gums
Locally to give relief.
Silicea (tds) : Gum boils with pus.
HAIR 327

HAIR

HAIR FALL

Acidum fluor. (tds) : Falling of hair after typhoid fever.
Acidum phos. (tds) : Falling of hair after an exhausting disease.
Hairfall from head, eyebrows, eyelashes, etc.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : Falling of hair in bunches on combing is cured
by the remedy.
Ferrum phos. (tds) : Hairfall from the head due to anemia.
Kalium carb. (tds) : For falling of hair due to dryness of the scalp
and dandruff.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Falling of hair after child birth. Hair come out
in excess while combing.
Nitricum acidum (tds) : Falling of pubic hair due to syphilis or
gonorrhea.
Sabal ser. (tds) : It is beneficial in the treatment of thinning hair.
Selenium met. (tds) : Useful for falling of pubic hair - if needed at
all.
Sepia (tds), : Use of either remedy stops falling of hair
Carbo veg. (tds) during pregnancy, after child birth and during
nursing of a child.
Sulphur (bd), : These remedies are also useful for the falling
Lycopodium (tds) of hair in nursing mothers. Lycopodium is also
useful for greying hair at a young age.
Sphingurus mar. (tds) : Falling out of hair from the beard.
Thallium (tds) : Falling of hair after diseases. Alopecia with
much perspiration on the head. Loss of hair as
an after-effect of bursting of an atom bomb.
Thuja occ. (tds) : Use this remedy when the hair grow slowly
and split after growing. Use it as a general
remedy for falling of hair.
Thymus serpyllum Q : Helps in the regrowth of hair.
Vinca minor (tds) : Use of this remedy cures matting of hair
together after a head wash.
328 HAIR—HAIR - PREMATURE GREYING—HAIR - UNWANTED

Wiesbaden 200 (od) : By the use of this remedy, the hair will grow
more rapidly than usual and become darker.
New hair take the place of the fallen hair
rapidly.

HAIR - PREMATURE GREYING
Hair contains a black-brown pigment and a yellow-red pigment. The amount and distribution of the pigments determine the hair color. When the secretion of the pigment is lessened, the shaft of the hair whitens. Normally hair gradually greys then whitens as people grow older and the quantity and distribution of the pigment decreases. This is determined by heredity. Stress or illness may also affect the formation of pigment. How to stop it is discussed below:
Acidum phos. 1c (hs) : Hair thin out and turn grey early and fall out.
Repeat every 15 days
Lycopodium (tds) : It is specific for premature greying of hair.
Natrium mur. (tds), : Use of either of these remedies when indica-Phosphorus (tds) ted or otherwise also stop further premature
greying of hair after diseases.
Pilocarpus 1000 (hs) : If the hair are greying prematurely due to dry-Repeat after 15 days ness of the scalp, the use of this remedy stops
it by stimulating natural secretion of the scalp.
Thyreoidinum 3x (tds) : It stops premature greying of hair due to
thyroid diseases. It also helps to restore the
natural color of hair not turned completely
grey.

HAIR - UNWANTED

FACIAL HAIR

Oleum jec. 3x (tds) : Give this remedy 3 times a day after the use of
Thuja occ. 1M.

HEARING - IMPAIRED
Hearing loss is generally gradual and painless in many cases developing so slowly that it is barely noticeable. At any age, hearing can be damaged by :
1. Middle ear infection.
2. Exposure to loud or constant noise.
3. Heredity.
4. Illness or birth defects.
5. The natural aging process.
6. Traumatic injury.
7. Tumors.
It is suggested that after the age of 50, a regular hearing test must be done.
It should also be done whenever hearing becomes impaired. Treatment should be done on the basis of the disease. In most of the cases (90%), it will be necessary to have a hearing aid which should be used on the advise of an ear specialist. In the rest of the 10% cases, the following medicines are suggested.

NOTE 4: Heart diseases are mostly caused due to the death of a heart muscle.
Heart muscles become starved for oxygen when cholesterol and fatty
deposits clog the blood ways.
NOTE 5: The heart beats roughly 100,000 times a day, pumps about 5 litres of
blood every minute, pumps nearly 23000 litres of blood per day, pumps
the entire blood supply around the body about once every minute, and
is about the size of one’s fist.

HEART ATTACK
(MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION)

Site of blockage in
coronary artery

Area of the heart
affected

A heart attack occurs when the blood supply to the heart muscle is se-verely reduced or stopped. This happens when one of the arteries (coronary
HEART ATTACK—HEELS 349

arteries) supplying blood to the heart muscle is blocked. If the blood supply to the heart muscle is cut off for longer than several minutes, muscle cells in the affected area suffer irreversible injury and die. As the heart cannot reproduce, heart muscle damage from the heart attack is permanent. A heart attack can result in disability or even death depending on how much and where the heart muscle is damaged. Over 90% of the heart attacks are caused by a blood clot in the coronary artery (coronary thrombosis or coronary occulusion). The for-mation of blood clots is often associated with atherosclerosis, the build up of plague (a combination of cholesterol, cellular waste and other materials) on the artery wall. When the plague ruptures, it can form a blood clot capable of blocking one of the coronary arteries. Serious atherosclerosis can also cause a heart attack by “blocking off” the flow of blood through the coronary artery.
Heart attacks can also occur by severe contraction or spasm in one of the coronary arteries. When this happens, the artery narrows and blood supply to the heart muscle is decreased or even stopped. It can occur in the normal ap-pearing blood vessels and vessels partly blocked by atherosclerosis.
Paleness, anxiety, fear, sweating, shortness of breath, indigestion, tight-ness or chest pain, over all weakness and nausea are general symptoms of a heart attack. Some individuals, particularly women may experience vague chest discomfort or think that they are having heartburn. Symptoms can come and go. Such a patient should immediately be referred to the nearest hospital or a heart specialist. About 40 percent of such patients die within 30 minutes of the attack.
For treatment, see chapters - Angina pectoris, Blood clots, Blood pres-sure, Cholesterol, Sclerosis, etc.

genital herpes experience repeated or recurrent outbreaks. This
happens when the body’s immune system is low, for example, at times

sharing intimate articles like towels and razors used on the area of
herpes and use safer sex methods.
NOTE 2: Shingles is caused by a reactivation of chickenpox or herpes virus

survives life long in people who have had that illness.
NOTE 3: Herpes is a nuisance but it is not life threatening. It can be avoided

process. Wash hands after touching the sores as other parts, especially
the eyes, when touched with infected hands can suffer from this
disease. Sex should be avoided otherwise the other partner will be
infected.

IMMUNE SYSTEM
(LYMPHATIC SYSTEM)

The immune lymphatic system is an infection fighting circulatory system
of body fluids and lymphocytes travelling in delicate vessels called ducts that
collect fluid squeezed from veins during normal metabolism, and bring it back
to the veins near the heart. The lymphatic fluid resembles blood serum, that is,
blood fluid containing only lymphocytes (white blood corpuscles without cy-Thoracic duct

IMMUNE SYSTEM 381

toplasmic granules, they are normally 20 -50 % of total white cells and may increase to 90 % in lymphatic leukemia) and is returned to the blood stream at various parts of the body so that the waste products can be removed by the kidneys. The lymphatic system also includes various infection fighting or lym-phocyte producing organs such as the spleen, tonsils, appendix, thymus and intestinal Peyer’s patches. A lymph node is a kidney or bean-shaped bin occuring along the lymphatic ducts. There are hundreds of them. It filters the lymphatic fluid and removes the disease forming materials. They stop cancer cells and in turn may become the seat of cancer themselves. The filtered pure lymph enters the main trunk for absorption into the blood. The lymph nodes are of the size of a pinhead to the size of an olive or an almond. Lymph is transparent but in the vessels draining the intestines, it is milky in color due to the presence of fats and is called “chyle”.

DISEASES OF THE IMMUNE SYSTEM

Everyone has experienced stomach discomfort or a bloated feeling at some point in their lives. But when it occurs regularly, it becomes a problem.
Many people instinctively reach for an antacid, thinking the discomfort is caused by excess acid.But often, they have normal healthy levels of acid (what the stomach needs to help process food). More likely, the problem is one of motility or reflux.

Motility is the natural wave-like action that moves food through the digestive system. When it's not working properly, food sits in the stomach and can cause discomfort, bloating and other symptoms. The pressure can also force stomach contents up, causing heartburn.
The solution is to get things moving again, and by restoring motility, relieve the stomach discomfort and other symptoms.
Reflux occurs when the lower esophageal sphincter is weak or relaxed, allowing stomach contents to flow back into the esophagus. This irritates the esophageal lining which is less protected than the stomach lining and causes heartburn. Diet and lifestyle modifications are an important part of the treatment.
Remedies as suggested in the chapter “Acidity” are helpful. Drinking a glass of water during the attack flushes down the food giving relief.

complication of diphtheria or paralysis of the soft palate.

INFERTILITY

When a lady is unable to have a child even aften a prolonged medical treatmant, many a couples employ high technical treatment and enjoy the joys of parenthood. Any of the following six procedures can be employed, only by a competent surgeon who specialized in this kind of treatment:
1. Intracytoplasmic sperm infection (I.C.S.I): Man’s sperm is injected
directly into his wife’s egg under a microscope. The embryo is then
implanted in the woman’s womb.
2. Ovulation induction: A woman who is unable to produce eggs, is treated
to produce a lot of eggs. The intercourse is timed for an optimal period
of the woman’s cycle to create the pregnancy.
3. Intra-uterine insemination (I. U. I.): Man’s sperm are collected and are
placed directly in the woman’s uterus. This type of insemination helps if
the man has a low count of sperms or they are slow in movement which
hampers their journey to the woman’s egg.
4. Invitro fertilization : Some of the woman’s eggs are combined with the
husband’s sperms in a petridish. If fertilization takes place, the embryo
is transferred into the woman’s uterus.
5. Gametic intra-fallopian transfer : An egg and sperm are directly
transferred into the fallopian tubes and on fertilization, it travels to the
uterus.
6. Another woman’s egg or another man’s sperm are employed to produce
the embryo which is then planted in the uterus of the barren woman.
NOTE 1: It is said that for obtaining a male child, the woman should take
Natrium mur. 6x one dose daily and for obtaining a female child,
she should take Pulsatilla nig. 6x one dose daily from 3rd to 6th
month of pregnancy.
NOTE 2: Aurum mur. CM , one dose given at the commencement of pregnancy
usually results in the birth of a male child.
NOTE 3: Doctors at the genetics and I.V.F. Institute Fairfax Va are researching
that a baby of choice-male or female can be produced. The only
difference between male producing Y chromosome sperm and female
producing X chromosome sperm is that Y chromosome sperms have
about 2.8 percent less genetic material.

and can be resolved by a change of prescription. Still others are caused

good nights rest:
1. Maintain a regular sleep schedule. Getting up at the same time every
morning synchronizes the body’s biological clock.
2. Keep the bedroom for sleeping. Do not read,watch TV or eat in
bed.
3. If you do not fall asleep within 20 minutes of going to bed, get up
and read or listen to quite music until you get sleepy.
4. Limit daytime naps.
5. Take a 20 to 30 minutes warm bath before bed.
6. Drink a glass of milk just before bed (warm or cold).
7. Avoid caffeinated beverages and chocalate in the afternoon and
evening.
8. Don’t drink alcohol before bed time. It can cause sleeplessness at
night.
9. Exercise during the day but not before going to bed.
10. According to Dr Anna Wirz - justice leader of the research team at
Psychiatric University Clinic of Chronobiology and Sleep
Laboratory, Switzerland, keeping the hands and feet warm in a
cold bedroom induces sleep quickly

NOTE: In pulmonary fibrosis, scar tissue forms in the lungs. The scarring
damages the alveoli where exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide
takes place in the lungs. It is neither a cancer nor is it contagious.
One of the causes is inhaling of fine metal or other solid particles.
When the cause is not known, it is called idiopathic pulmonary
fibrosis. Dry cough and shortness of breath are the first visible signs.
It is confirmed by X-rays or CT scan or biopsy. Conventional
treatment consists of administration of corticosteriods and in
homeopathy the inflammation is reduced by the above remedies
selected according to the symptoms.

LUPUS
(ULCERATING SKIN DISEASE)

Structure : This is a form of epithelial cancer and is also
called “eating cancer”.
Symptoms : It first appears on the nose as a hard, dusky
red sore and spreads in an ulcerative form
destroying the tissues till the bones are
exposed. This affects women 10 times more
than men. It usually appears in women between
the age of 20 - 40 years, although it can occur
at any age. Nausea, vomiting and abdominal
pain may accompany. It is an ulcerative skin
disease and requires a long time treatment.
Sensitivity to sun light is usually present.
Causes : Lupus is caused by disruption of body waste
disposal system from failure of special enzyme
“D Nasil” which fails to remove wastes from
the body.
Diagnostic tests : The disease is easily noticeable as it is outside
the body on the skin and biopsy is performed
to confirm it.

cut out.

NOTE 1: In 1851, the French dermatologist Cazenave employed the Latin term
‘Lupus’ (meaning wolf) to describe the skin rash that spread over
the bridge of the nose and cheeks in a characteristic butterfly shape.
Why he named it so, is unclear. The disease affects women 8 to 10
times more than men.It usually appears in women between the ages
of 20-40 years, although it can occur at any age. Nausea, vomiting
and abdominal pain may accompany. It is an ulcerating skin disease
and requires a very long treatment. Illness is more common in women.
NOTE 2: A study published in June 2000 issue of the journal “Nature Genetics”
New York by scientists - Mark Walpart of London, Essen of Germany
and other researchers shows that lupus is caused by disruption of
body's waste disposal system from failure of special enzyme “D
Nasel”, which fails to remove wastes from the body.

458 MENOPAUSE

MENOPAUSE
(CHANGE OF LIFE)

In women, it occurs between 35-55 years of life. Menses may stop suddenly or there maybe decreased flow each month until there is a final cessation or the periods maybe lengthened until complete cessation is accomplished. Surgical menopause occurs in almost 50% of women aged 50-64 years. It is surgically induced by removal of ovaries irrespective of age, characterizing end of child bearing years. In men, it is called “andropause”
(instead of menopause) and generally occurs between the age of 50-60 years when some changes in his behavior maybe noticed. When the menstruation of a woman halts, the estrogen level begins to drop.
The decrease in production of “estrogen” results in thinning of vagina and loss of elasticity of mucous membranes of vulva, vagina and other tissues like that of breasts. It also causes dryness of vagina and its itching, and sometimes discomfort or pain during sexual intercourse. For the same reason, the urinary stream maybe slowed down, there maybe difficulty in urination, increase in urination both during the day and night and voiding of urine on coughing or sneezing or urine may escape if the urge to it is not attended to immediately.
Fatigue, insomnia, headache, irritability, depression, loss of memory and concentration are series of conditions associated with climacteric. All these symptoms have been dealt with under the appropriate heads and maybe consulted in case of need. One more condition that occurs in the post-menopausal period over the age of 50 is called ‘osteoporosis’. Research has shown that almost 25% women in this period suffer from this disease. In this disease, amount of bone being produced by the body falls short of the amount that is naturally lost over time and excessive calcification of bones occurs causing spontaneous fractures and a marble-like appearance. For this also refer to the chapter on bones and fractures. Calcarea phos. and Symphytum off. (tincture) will be found useful. Weight bearing exercises, calcium supplements and soyabean foods are helpful during this difficult period of change of life. During this period, ovaries shut down and female eggs are not produced. It is estimated that women are born with 800000 eggs but the number dwindles with age. At about 37, about 25000 eggs are left, the decline speeds up and ovaries shrink until most of the eggs are depleted and menopause occurs around 50, plus or minus seven or eight years.

NOTE 1: So far, the exact cause of migraine is not known. It is, however, a
genetic or hereditary condition which can be triggered by diet,
weather changes, emotional stress, a change in sleep patterns or
hormonal fluctuations. During an attack, blood vessels in the brain
dialate and nerves become inflammed.
NOTE 2: Here are some ways of minimizing the headache:
a. Get up and go to bed at the same time each day.
b. Always eat at the same time of the day.
c. Stretch neck and shoulders regularly.
d. Take a few deep breaths each day.
NOTE 3: Women are three times more likely than men to suffer from
migraines, specially women between the age 21 to 50 years.
NOTE 4: Citrus fruits and juices, caffeine containing things, butter milk, aged

migraine.
NOTE 5: Eating oily fish, three times a week may protect against migraine
because of their Omega-3 fatty acids. Whole grains are also helpful.
NOTE 6: The patient should be adviced that as soon as he feels that he will
get migraine, he should lie down in a well ventilated dark room. It
cuts short the attack and in some cases, may cure it eventually.

MILK
Milk is one of the most precious gifts of nature. It is a perfect food and contains all the nourishment for growth like vitamin A, B, C and D in sufficient quantities. It has sugar and fats just in the right quantity.It is easily digested and is an essential diet for all infants, children - young or old, ladies and men.It is life for a child for the first few months of its birth. It contains antibodies which are present in the mother’s milk, number of enzymes, proteins, etc. If it causes disorders, the following remedies can be used to remove the disorders.
See chapter “Lactation” also.
Choosing to breast feed is one of the best things a mother can do for her baby. It has tremendous advantages for the mother and her baby. It develops a close relationship between the child with the mother. Nature has formulated mother’s milk specially for her child. It provides all the nutrients needed in an ideal proportion. As the baby grows, the nutrient contents of mother’s milk also change to satisfy the infants growth and changing needs. Breast milk is safe, convinient and always at the perfect temperature. It is available whenever the baby needs it. Several studies indicate that breast feeding may induce an infant's immune system to mature more quickly than the formula fed child. It protects the child against several diseases like diarrhea, lower respiratory infections, otitis media, bacteremia, urinary tract infection, insulin dependent diabetes mellitus, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, allergies and carcinoma.

To control obesity and to reduce fats, individualization of the case is necessary. Weight gain is the result of several different facts like genetics, heredity metabolism, inadequate elimination, eating habits and life style. The homeopathic treatment is based upon draining, treating and curing. Drainage means relieving the liver,kidneys and circulatory system of toxins. Fucus is a diuretic and detoxifying agent. It activates burning of fats and sugar. If you forgot to take off your rings before sleeping at night, then next morning you cannot take them off because your fingers are so swollen and after some hours when you pass urine, etc. the fingers become normal. In such cases, Natrium sulph. acts as a powerful drainage agent. The following medicines can be prescribed for people who are over-weight. These will not help people who just want to lose 5-10 pounds. To get restored to a more normal body and to take off the weight, the patient must know how to eat properly and exercise.
Fats should be decreased to minimum in the diet . Fasting and dieting can be more harmful even than being fat as most people gain back the lost weight after dieting is abondoned.
Extreme dieting can lead to eating disorders like anorexia nervosa and bulimia. There are no magic pills.
Regular physical activity and a low calorie diet help reduce obesity. Experts link obesity to diabetes, heart disease and some cancers.

OSTEOPOROSIS
Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by the loss of normal density of bone, resulting in fragile bone. It leads to literally abnormally porous bone that is more compressible like a sponge, than dense like a brick. This disorder of the skeleton weakens the bone causing an increase in the risk for fracture.
Normal bone is composed of protein, collagen, and calcium all of which gives bone its strength. Bones that are affected by osteoporosis can break with relatively minor injury that normally would not cause a bone fracture. The fracture can be either in the form of cracking, or collapsing. The spine, hips, and wrists are common areas of bone fractures from osteoporosis, although osteoporosis-related fractures can also occur in almost any skeletal bone.
The strength of the bones can be determined by bone mass (bone density). Generally, the higher the bone density, the stronger are the bones.
Bone density is greatly influenced by genetic factors, which in turn are sometimes modified by environmental factors and medications. Normally, bone density accumulates during childhood and reaches a peak by around age 25. It is then maintained for about ten years. After age 35, both men and women will normally lose 0.3% to 0.5% of their bone density per year as part of the ageing process. Estrogen is important in maintaining bone density in women.
When estrogen levels drop after menopause bone loss accelerates. Accelerated bone loss after menopause is a major cause of osteoporosis in women. Patients with osteoporosis have no symptoms until bone fractures occur.

For pains, in a particular part of the body or an organ, see under the appropriate heading. Following are the general characteristics of pains. These have proved to be a useful guide but it is not all.
How pain travels
Despite years of research, questions still remain about exactly what happens between the moment you step on a nail and the moment you say
“ouch”. Scientists are scrambling to answer these questions in their search for new pain relievers.
1. Receptors at the end of nerves in the skin, muscles, bone, blood vassels
and internal organs detect a potentially harmful stimulus.
2. A pain message in the form of electrical impulses travels along the nerve to
the spinal cord.
3. The pain message enters the dorsal horn, where the peripheral nerve
releases chemical transmitters that activate a number of nerve cells in the
spinal cord.
4. The spinal cord processes the information and transmits it to the brain via
other nerve cells. The spinal cord usually sends a signal for the muscles to
contract, to move the limb away from pain.
5. The message is forwarded to several specialized regions of the brain that
control physical sensation, emotional feeling and thinking.

Carbo veg. (tds) : Profuse sweat on the forehead. Patient has to
wipe it off with the hand.
Chelidonium (tds) : Sweat stains the clothes yellow.
China off. (tds) : Perspiration during sleep or on being covered.
Colchicum autum. (tds) : Profuse sweat accompanied with gastric
ailments.Bad effects from suppressed sweats.
Colocynthis (tds) : Perspiration smells like urine.
Conium mac. (tds) : Sweating of head, hands, palms, etc. as soon
as one sleeps or even when closing the eyes.
Dulcamara (tds) : Palms wet with perspiration. It generally
happens in thyroid disease.
Ferrum phos. (tds) : Sweating in acute infectious diseases.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : Cold and foul foot sweats.
Hydrocotyle (tds) : Perspiration copious.
Iodium (tds) : Perspiration on little exertion on account of
weakness.
542 PERSPIRATION

Lachesis (bd) : Perspiration is absent.
Ledum pal. (tds) : Warm sweat on hands and feet, increases with
the heat of the bed. It is worse on waking.
Lycopodium (tds) : Sweat smells like the smell of onions, and it
disappears on movement.
Magnesium mur. (tds) : For foot sweat.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Inclination to perspire easily.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Palms hot and always wet with perspiration.
Natrium mur. (tds), : Perspiration while eating. This condition is
Chamomilla (tds) called gustatory sweating and mostly occurs
in diabetes. Craving for salt.
Nitricum acidum (tds) : Sweat all over the body after a meal.
Petroleum (tds), : Fetid perspiration.
Sulphur (tds), Silicea (tds),
Mercurius sol. (tds),
Staphysagria (tds)
Pilocarpus (tds), : Very copious perspiration. Pilocarpus has
Hydrocotyle (tds) drops of perspiration all over the body.
Psorinum 200 (hs) : There is profuse sweating after the cure of
diseases. Sweating feels pleasant.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Sweating on one side of the face only.
Rhus tox. (tds), Silicea (tds) : Offensive sweat of armpits and feet as
indicated with other symptoms. Perspiration
on palms and soles.
Rhus g. (tds), : Profuse sweating due to mental or physical
China off. (tds) weakness.
Sepia (bd) : Excessive and fetid sweating on feet, groins
and armpits is cured by use of this remedy.
Salvia off. Q (tds) : Controls excessive sweating when circulation
of blood is weak. It exerts a tonic influence on
the skin. A single dose of 20 drops in a little
water shows results after 2 hours and action
persists for about 6 days.
Silicea (tds) : Offensive sweat on icy cold feet. The foot feels
sore. Profuse sweat on the head, extending to
the neck. Offensive sweat in armpits.
PERSPIRATION—PHARYNGITIS 543

Strychninum phos. 3x (tds) : Hands and axillae are covered with sticky,
fetid sweat.
Sulphur (bd) : Smell of garlic-like sweat in the armpits. Hands
hot and sweaty.
Thuja occ. 200 (hs) : Sweat smells like honey and is only on the
Repeat after a week uncovered parts except face.
Tuberculinum 200 (hs) : Profuse sweating in tuberculosis of lungs, with
loss of weight. Stains yellow. Sweating of
palms.
Veratrum alb. (tds) : Cold perspiration specially on the forehead in
all diseases.

PHARYNGITIS

Arum dracontium (tds) : Throat is raw, tender and sore; pharynx is
inflammed. Shooting pain in the ear maybe
present. There is a continuous effort to clear
the throat. Hoarseness and excess of mucus in
the posterior nares.
Belladonna (tds) : Swelling of uvula and stinging in the throat.
Pharyngitis with small bleeding ulcers.
Cistus can. (tds) : Dryness of the throat, patient likes to drench it
by sipping water. Pain in the throat worse by
inhaling cold air.
Elaps cor. 6 (tds) : For chronic naso-pharyngeal catarrh with
greenish crusts and bad smell, it is specific.
Kalium bich. (tds) : Pharyngitis with tough stringy and ropy mucus.
Sensation of a thorn in the throat.
Kalium mur. (tds) : A routine but a good remedy for the disease.
Tonsils are swollen.
Lycopodium (tds) : Difficulty in swallowing. Mucous membrane
of the throat appears pale.
Mentholum (tds) : It is curative in pharyngitis. Use 2 doses a day.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Suits the patients of pharyngitis with
544 PHARYNGITIS—PHLEGM

constipation,dryness of the throat and
excessive thirst.
Phytolacca dec. (tds) : Pharyngitis with small white ulcers in the
throat.Pain in the throat with a bluish look.
Sanguinaria (tds) : Pharyngitis, worse on the right side.
Appearance of redness in the throat.
Silicea (tds) : Pharyngitis with a sore throat and chronic
catarrh.
Sticta pulm. (tds) : Coryza with a frequent desire to blow the nose.
Wyethia (tds) : It is an excellent remedy for pharyngitis and
for singers and public speakers. Throat is
irritable and there is a dry hacking cough due
to tingling in the larynx.

PHLEGM
(MUCUS)

Causticum (tds) : Cough with mucus lodged under the sternum,
which is difficult to dislodge and expel.
Corallium rub. (tds) : Post-nasal catarrh. Profuse secretion of mucus
dropping through the posterior nares.
Graphites (od) : Phlegm with extreme sensibility to strong
smells. There are crusts inside the nostrils and
cracks on the nose. It is painful to blow the
nose.
Hydrastis (tds) : Mucus is yellow-green, thin and excoriating.
It accompanies coryza when the nose runs
constantly. Thick mucus falls at the back of
the nose.
Kalium bich. (tds) : Mucus is greenish-yellow and stringy which
can be drawn into long strings or is ball-like
and sticks on the tongue. It falls at the back of
the nose, into the throat.
Kalium mur. (tds) : Mucus that occurs in the second stage of cold,
is thick and white, and falls from the posterior
nares in the throat.
PHLEGM—PHOTOPHOBIA—PHTHISIS—PILES—PITUITARY GLAND 545

Natrium carb. (tds) : Catarrh of the posterior nares. Hawking much
mucus from the throat, worse slightest draught.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Mucus like the white of an egg or transparent
and is very profuse. There maybe loss of smell
and taste.
Phytolacca dec. (tds) : Flow of mucus from one nostril and from the
posterior nares.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Yellow mucus with a stuffed nose and with pain
above the eyes or in the right cheek bone. The
patient has a weeping tendency.

PHOTOPHOBIA
(DREAD OF LIGHT)
(SEE ‘LIGHT’)

PHTHISIS
(SEE ‘TUBERCULOSIS’)

PILES
(SEE ‘HEMORRHOIDS’)

PIMPLES
(SEE ‘ACNE’)

PITUITARY GLAND
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Dysfunction of the pituitary gland.
Hekla lava 3x (tds) : Tumors of the pituitary gland.
546 PITUITARY GLAND—PLAGUE

Anterior pituitary (Adenohypophysis)

Neurohypophysis
Adenohypophysis

Thyreoidinum 2x (tds) : Excessive activity of the pituitary gland and
fibroid tumors in the pituitary gland.
NOTE : The pituitary gland regulates the release of growth hormone. People
who have their pituitary gland removed, do not grow properly.

PLAGUE

Iodium (tds) : Acts prominently on corrective tissues and
constriction of larynx on account of plague.
Operculina turp. (tds) : Plague with fever and diarrhea. Lymphatic
glands enlarged and indurated. Boils and
slowly suppurating abscesses.
Tarentula cub. (tds) : A curative and preventive remedy, specially
during the period of invasion.
PLEURISY 547

PLEURISY
(INFLAMMATION OF THE PLEURA)

Exudate on both, parietal and
visceral layers — pale grey

Adhesions between layers of pleura

Small quantity of fluid at base of cavity

Above the fluid, the fibrin covered
layers of pleura are adherent

Lung is collapsed by fluid
pressure

Diaphragm depressed by fluid

Aconitum nap. (tds) : It should be the first remedy which should be
thought in a case of chest pains. Bryonia should
be given if it fails to relieve in one day.
Antimonium ars. 3x (tds) : Wet pleurisy with inflammation of cardiac
muscular tissues and membranes enclosing the
heart. Excessive dyspnea and cough with much
mucus secretion. Accumulation of fluids in the
pleura (pleural effusion), and catarrhal
pneumonia.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Pleurisy resulting from injury inflicted by a
broken rib may yield completely to the use of
this medicine. If a supplement is needed,
Bryonia and Kalium carb. compete for choice.

chapters.title: Section 24 (Pages 576-600)
chapters.content:
548 PLEURISY—PNEUMONIA

Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Great restlessness. Drinks often but little at a
time. Burning pains in the chest relieved by
warmth.
Bryonia alba (tds) : Stitching pains in the chest worse by any
motion and better by rest and cold things. Dry
pleurisy.
Cantharis (tds) : Great burning in the chest and also burning in
the urethra when urinating.
China off. (tds) : Pleurisy with fever and great weakness.
Hepar sulphuris (tds) : Pleurisy complicated with bronchitis.
Formation of pus in the chest. Wet pleurisy.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Breathlessness. Burning pains in the chest.
Cough.
Kalium sulph. (tds) : Applicable in the later stages of the
inflammation. Rattling of mucus in the chest.
Yellow expectoration and pus formation.
Ranunculus bulb. (tds) : Pain in the muscles of the ribs. Chilliness in
the chest when walking in open air. Rheumatic
pains in the chest. Pleurodynia.
NOTE: In pleurisy, rest is essential. The patient should have no more exercise
than bathroom privileges. Increase the fluid intake. In acute cases,
the affected side should be strapped to immobilize the chest.

PNEUMONIA
Arsenicum iod. (tds) : Chronic pneumonia when abscess is about to
form in the lung.
Aconitum nap. (tds) : A remedy for the first stage of pneumonia. A
high fever preceded by chill. The pulse is hard
and the skin is dry. Dry painful cough. The
cause maybe dry cold winds. When thick
expectoration starts, Aconitum nap. ceases to
be the remedy.
Antimonium tart. (tds) : Great rattling of mucus but very little is
expectorated and that also with some effort.
Threatened paralysis of the lungs.
PNEUMONIA 549

Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Dyspnea. Thirst, drinks often but little. Fever
with restlessness.
Bryonia alba (tds) : If the above remedies fail to cure, use of this
remedy is indicated. Cough is loose and there
are sharp sticking pains in the chest.
Breathlessness; the patient wants to be still.
Chelidonium (tds), : Fan-like movements of alae nasi. Pain under
Lycopodium (tds) the corner of right shoulder blade is a sure
indication for the use of Chelidonium.
Ferrum phos. 6x (qid) : In the beginning of the disease or in the later
stages when there is bleeding from the lungs.
Repeat it every 2 hours. A suitable remedy for
fever.
Iodium 3x (tds) : It can be indicated in any stage of pneumonia.
There is cough and difficulty in breathing. The
sputum is bloody. Repeat it every hour when
indicated.
Ipecacuanha (tds) : Nausea. Wheezing cough. Chest feels full of
phlegm but does not yield to cough. Pneumonia
in children.
Kalium mur. (tds) : This remedy in alternation with Ferrum phos.
has achieved very good results in this disease.
The mucus is thick and white.
Lycopodium (tds) : Neglicted, maltreated and imperfectly treated
cases of pneumonia are cured by the use of the
remedy.
Phosphorus 200 (hs) : Give one dose if Antimonium tart. and Bryonia
fail. It follows Bryonia very well. This remedy
is more often indicated and gives curative
results.
Tuberculinum 1M (hs) : Broncho-pneumonia in children. Hard hacking
cough. Profuse sweat and loss of weight. Rales
all over the chest.
Veratrum vir. (tds) : Extreme congestion of the chest, oppression
of breathing. Dyspnea. Nausea and vomiting.
LEGIONNAIRES DISEASE

This illness is a form of penumonia found naturally. People are exposed
550 PNEUMONIA—POLIO

to the bacteria when they breathe in air contaminated with droplets of water containing the organism. Symptoms include high fever, chills and cough as well as fatigue, headache, muscle pain, chest pain and loss of appetite. This bacteria best thrives in warm water and often spreads through air conditioning water and plumbing systems. The treatment is the same as for pneumonia and on symptoms.

POLIO
Calcarea phos. 12x (tds), : Two grains of each mixed together, 3 doses
Natrium mur. 12x (tds), a day for 3 months. All the medicines
Kalium Phos. 12x (tds), should be stopped during this course.
Embelica off. (hs) : 10 drops a dose in the morning daily for few
months.
Gelsemium 6-CM : In increasing potencies, it cures polio. Use 6
potency, 2 doses per day for a month, 30
potency 2 doses per day for a month and 200
potency, one dose every 5th day for 2 months
and CM potency, one dose a month for 3
months till cured.
Hypericum 12x (bd) : Two doses a day for 1-3 months in the morning
and at noon.
Lathyrus sat. 30 (bd) : Two doses daily for 1-3 months in the evening
and at bed time.
Thuja occ. 200 (hs) : Start the treatment with this remedy. No other
remedy should be given on that day.
NOTE: Watch the following symptoms of post polio syndrome for the
indicated remedy:
1. Unaccustomed fatigue requiring the patient to rest during mid-day or earlier.
2. New joint and muscular pains.
3. Muscular weakness or loss of muscle use even in the muscles which
did not bother while suffering from polio.
4. Respiratory or swallowing problems.
5. Unusual intolerance of cold which causes muscular weakness or a
burning pain or discoloration of limbs.
6. Psychological stress.
POLYPUS 551

POLYPUS
(SOFT TUMOR)

Gross edema

Dilated blood
vessels Polypi

Thickened
basement
membrane

Lymphocytes,
plasma cells
and frequently
Adenoid
eosinophilia

An abnormal growth from the mucous membrane resembling a tumor but not cancerous; commonly found in the nose, uterus, rectum and sometimes in the ear and larynx. There is a risk of the polyp becoming cancerous or increasing in size or number.
Alumina (tds) : Polypus of the left nostril of the nose. The
peculiar constipation confirms the use of this
remedy.
Berberis vulg. (tds) : Polypus of the vocal cord without roots and
having an angry reddish look.
Calcarea carb. 200 (hs) : A good remedy for polypus of the nose, ear,
Repeat after one week bladder, uterus, etc. It should be repeated after
7 days. Mucus polypus which bleeds easily.
Calcarea iod. 3x (tds) : Polypi of the nose and ear.
Calcarea phos. (tds) : A large polypus of the nose extending to the
brain.
Cholesterinum (tds) : Polypus of the gall bladder in a pre-cancerous
stage. Burning pain in the liver region. General
debility.
552 POLYPUS

Conium mac. (tds) : Uterine polypus which protrudes while passing
urine. Bleeding polypus of the nose.
Formica rufa (tds) : Stops development of polypi and reduces the
size. It is an effective remedy, specially for
polypi of the ears.
Kalium bich. (tds) : Polypus of the air passages.
Kalium nit. (tds) : Polypus of the nose or elsewhere specially on
the right side with headache or heaviness of
the head after eating and in the morning or
towards the evening.
Lachesis 200 (hs) : Polypus of the left ear with severe pain. Sensi-Repeat after a week tive to air.
Lemna minor (tds) : Nasal polypi. Swollen mucous membranes of
the nose. Atrophic rhinitis. Fetid smell.
Reduces the obstruction of the nose by
reducing the swelling.
Mercurius sol. (tds) : Polypus. Blockage of the ear, bleeds easily
and affects the hearing. Right ear is mostly
involved.
Phosphorus (bd) : Nasal polypi bleeding easily. Handkerchief is
always bloody. Imaginary odors. Craving for
cold drinks. Sneezing. Polypus of the uterus.
Sanguinaria (tds) : Polypus of the nose or larynx. Smarting and
burning in the nose and throat. Nose
obstructed. Bleeding from removal of crusts.
Sepia (tds) : Polypi of uterus with copious menses.
Silicea 6x (tds) : Blockage of nose; nostrils inflamed. Patient
chilly. Perforation of septum.
Taxus baccata Q : Bright red polypus of the ear with shooting
pain is cured by the use of this remedy. A single
dose gives results.
Teucrium mar. CM (hs) : It is one of the best remedies for polypus of
Repeat after 15 days the nose. Three - four doses repeated after an
interval of 15 days usually cures permanently.
It cures polypus of the rectum also. Blockage
of the nose on the side patient lies on. It cures
polypus of vagina too. Polypus is soft and of
jelly-like consistency.
POLYURIA 553

Thuja occ. 20 (hs) : Polypus of the middle ear and uterus with a
Repeat after a week chronic tendency.

POLYURIA
(SEE ALSO ‘URINE’)

Acidum mur. (tds) : Urine escapes while passing wind. Polyuria
day and night with copious urine.
Alfalfa Q (bd) : Polyuria. Frequent urging to urinate.
10 drops in ½ cup of water
Alumina (tds) : Frequent urination but it requires much
straining to pass it. The urine is burning and
sometimes mixed with yellowish pus.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Frequent and profuse urination.
Causticum (tds) : Frequent urination at night. It takes a long time
to finish.
Chelidonium (tds) : Frequent desire. Urine is copious. Maybe
milky in color and foams like beer.
Eryngium aqua. (tds) : Frequent urination every half an hour.
Dribbling and burning in the urethra before
and after passing urine.
Ignatia amara (tds) : Polyuria of hysterical subjects and frequent
urination after drinking tea and alcohol.
Ledum pal. (tds) : Polyuria. Urine maybe copious or little. The
stream of urine often stops during urination.
Nux vomica (tds) : Frequent urination on account of indigestion.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Specially indicated in ladies. Dribbling of
urine. Has to rush to urinate or it escapes.
Sabal ser. Q (tds) : Prostate gland enlarged. Constant desire to
10 drops in ½ cup of water pass urine.
Vesicaria Q (bd) : Polyuria worse during night. Has to pass urine
10 drops in ½ cup of water every 15 minutes or so due to inflammation of
the bladder or a kidney trouble. Blood, pus,
albumin, etc. in the urine is cured by the use of
this remedy.
554 PREGNANCY

PREGNANCY

Normal Delivery

For details of a particular symptom during pregnancy also see the particular head in this book.
Bearing down : See ‘Prolapsus’ , ‘Uterus’.
Cough : See ‘Cough’.
Dropsy : See ‘Dropsy’.
Miscarriage : See ‘Abortion’.
Agaricus mus. (tds) : For weakness of the lower extremities.
Alumina (tds) : Craving for eating chalk, lime, soil or charcoal.
Amygdalus per. Q (tds) : This is a very good remedy for ‘morning
10 drops in ½ cup of water sickness’. Constant nausea and vomiting in
pregnant women and also gastric and intestinal
irritation.
Anacardium ori. (tds) : Dyspepsia and insomnia.
PREGNANCY 555

Antimonium crud. (tds) : Loss of appetite. Desire for acids, bitter lemon,
pickles, etc.
Apocynum can. (tds) : It is useful when there is albuminuria or some
kidney problem.
Arnica mont. : For mis-step or an accident during pregnancy
- when the miscarriage is threatened, repeat
every 15 minutes till the desired results are
achieved.
Bellis per. (tds) : Backache and inability to walk.
Cocculus ind. (tds) : Bleeding during pregnancy due to lack of
sleep. Clotted blood with spasmodic colic.
Nausea and backache specially of light haired
and romantic females.
Conium mac. (tds) : Breasts become painful. Constipation.
Ficus ind. Q (tds) : It is a very useful remedy for all sorts of
10 drops in ½ cup of water abnormal bleeding before and after pregnancy.
Gratiola off. (tds) : Vertigo. Dyspepsia, dysphagia, cramps and
colic with wind in the abdomen. Constipation
or diarrhea - stool forcibly evacuated without
pain.
Ipecacuanha (tds) : Nausea and vomiting in pregnancy.
Kalium carb. (tds) : For weakness in general.
Lac def. (tds) : Vomiting during the first quarter of pregnancy.
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Toothache during pregnancy.
Manganum acet. (tds) : Desire for always lying down in bed.
Murex purp. (tds) : Walking difficult in pregnancy because of
weakness in all joints. Must lie down from
weakness but her symptoms worsen on lying
down and after sleep.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Unnatural and excessive craving for salt during
pregnancy.
Nitricum acidum (tds), : Longing for indigestible things like chalk,
Calcarea phos. (tds) sand, etc.
Phosphorus (bd) : Albuminuria during pregnancy.
Pulsatilla nig. (bd) : Give it in 30 potency when the position of the
556 PREGNANCY

unborn child is not normal i.e., head is not below
and is upside or lying sideways. It also avoids
displacement of the uterus and keeps it in the
right place.
Secale cor. 6 (tds) : Discharge of blood during pregnancy.
Sepia (tds) : It is a good remedy for toothache or
constipation during pregnancy. It is useful
when there is always an urgent desire to void
urine and if not voided in time, a few drops
may escape. It is also useful in vomiting of
pregnancy. Unusual bleeding during pregnancy
from 5th to 7th month or a habitual abortion
from 3rd to 7th month. Constipation during
pregnancy.
Stramonium (tds) : Symptoms of insanity or mania during
pregnancy.
Sulphur (od) : Sensation in the abdomen as if a child is
kicking from inside.
Sulphur 6 (od), : If a women gives birth habitually to babies who
Calcarea phos. 6x (od) die soon after birth or early in infancy, give
these medicines one dose each, daily during
the last two months of pregnancy. The child
should be given Alfalfa Q, 5 drops, three times
a day for several months, 10 minutes before
each feed.
Symphoricarpus 200 (od) : It is a routine prescription for vomiting during
pregnancy. The leading symptom is relief from
lying on the back. Nausea is worse from any
motion. Appetite lost.
Symphytum off. (tds) : Persistent vomiting.
Tabacum 200 (hs) : Vomiting during pregnancy with much spitting
sometimes of stool-like things. Uncovering of
abdomen lessens nausea and vomiting.
Thuja occ. (tds) : Violent movements and kicking of the child
inside the abdomen. It compels the mother to
urinate on account of pressure on the urinary
bladder.
PREGNANCY—PRE-MENSTRUAL SYNDROME 557

Tuberculinum 200 (hs) : Always in best of health during pregnancy
and then goes down rapidly after confinement.
Viburnum prun. Q (bd) : 5 drops a dose will cure cramps during
pregnancy.
NOTE 1: It is said that for obtaining a male child, the woman should take
Natrium mur. 6x, one dose daily and for obtaining a female child,
Pulsatilla 6x, one dose daily from 3rd to 5th month of pregnancy. In
the first weeks of gestation, male and female embryos develop a like
— both start with what are called undifferentiated gonads that can
turn out to be ovaries or testes and will all become females except for
the intervention of contain factors that put us into the male line. For
those factors to operate, the Y chromosome is needed. Females have
an XX sex chromosome compound and man XY which is genetically
determined the moment the sperm fertilizes the egg. It is the Y
portion that ultimately decides to build testes or breasts.
NOTE 2: Aurum mur. CM (one dose) given at the time of commencement of
pregnancy usually results in birth of a male child.
NOTE 3: More and more women are now opting for a caesarean section because
it is easy and safe. It is advantageous when the baby is in a wrong
position for a vaginal birth and where the woman does not want any
more children. The risk of complications grows with each surgery.
Now the surgery can be performed while the woman is awake using
modern anesthetics. A small incision is made which is less disfiguring
than the previous method.

PRE-MENSTRUAL SYNDROME
(P.M.S.)
Calcarea carb. (tds) : PMS with fluid retention, particularly swollen
tender breasts, painful joints, weakness, lack
of energy, depression, tearfulness, irritability,
anxiety and fear of insanity.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : PMS with extreme tearfulness, depression, self
pity, anxiety about the future, tendency to gain
weight before menses and possibly headache,
nausea and dizziness.
Sepia (tds) : PMS with marked indifference to the loved
ones. Irritability, tearfulness, difficulty in
concentrating, a desire to get away from
558 PRICKLY HEAT—PROLAPSUS

everything, extreme anger, fits of screaming,
sensation of uterus coming out of the vagina,
accompanied by an oily skin and desire for too
salty or too sweet food. Such conditions usually
occur at approach of menopause.

PRICKLY HEAT
(SEE ‘SUMMER RASH’)

PROLAPSUS

RECTUM

Acidum mur. (tds) : Prolapse while urinating.
Aesculus glabra : Prolapse of rectum with much pain in rectum.
Pain shoots to the back. Swollen mucus
membranes obstruct stool passage.
Aloe soc. (tds) : Prolapse of the rectum with diarrhea, bleeding
and tenesmus.
Ferrum phos. 6x (qid) : Prolapse of rectum in children.
Podophyllum (tds) : Rectal prolapse after a stool, by sneezing,
coughing and with diarrhea. Stools of green
or yellow color. Worse in the morning. Useful
for both women and children.
Ruta (tds) : Prolapse at slightest attempt to pass stool.
Prolapse after labor in women.
Sepia (tds) : Prolapse of the rectum with weight like a ball
in the rectum.
UTERUS
Aloe soc. (tds) : Prolapse of the uterus with diarrhea.
Belladonna (tds) : Bearing down with sensation as if everything
will be passed out of the vulva. Fetid discharge.
PROLAPSUS 559

Kalium carb. 200 (hs) : Prolapse of the uterus after labor. One dose
Repeat after 1 week after 7 days if necessary. Not to be repeated
often.
Lachesis (bd) : Prolapse of uterus during menopause.
Lilium tig. (tds) : Sensation as if the entire contents of the pelvis
will pass through the vagina. Dragging from
the naval. Constant desire to pass urine.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Prolapse uteri with cutting in the urethra.
Bearing down pains worse in the morning.
Podophyllum (tds) : Prolapse of uterus after delivery of a child.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Bearing down sensation with pains worse lying
down.
Sepia (tds) : It is the most effective remedy in prolapsus
uteri, misplacement of the uterus or its
inversion, etc. It restores the uterus to the
normal position within a few days without
manual intervention even in 30 potency. Higher
potencies will work well in chronic cases. Must
cross limbs to prevent protrusion of parts.
Stannum met. (tds) : It is another strong remedy for prolapse of the
uterus. It also strengthens the ligaments of the
uterus. Prolapse is worse during passage of
stool.
Tilia eur. (tds) : Bearing down feeling as if everything will
protrude out of the vulva. Leucorrhea. Prolapse

and papaya.

of the major causes of cancer of prostate.
NOTE: Prostate is a small gland about the size of a chestnut, situated just
below the bladder. It secretes fluid which transports the sperms
during ejaculation. Women do not have a prostate.
NOTE: The prostate gland is not always affected in urinary problems. It is
best to consult an urologist (i.e., a person who specializes in dealing

NOTE 5: Prostate cancer patients are being effectively treated by using a

gland.

PSORIASIS
Psoriasis is a chronic skin disorder that causes thick, silvery, scaly, red patches to appear on the skin. A specific type of arthritis is frequently associated with the disease.
It can be on any part of the body but rarely on the face. The cause is unknown and it responds to homeopathic treatment very well. The treatment is lengthy and requires patience. The disease lessens in severity in summer and goes into remission from time to time with no apparent reason.

too much animal fat in diet. Hence, long term dietary changes with

affects the brain. The virus is usually transmitted through saliva but
can also be passed on through a cut, scratch or moist tissue in the nose

painful spasms followed by excessive saliva. Death occurs within seven
days if not treated properly.

other parts of the body. It is a slowly progressive, chronic disease of
the central nervous system that interferes with the brain’s, ability to
control functions such as seeing, walking and talking. Symptoms vary
and can range from numbness in an arm or leg to severe paralysis.

10 drops in ½ cup of water absent or are in low count. Weak and thin

NOTE: Semen is a mixed product of various glands. Prostate gland secretes a
thin and slightly alkaline fluid which forms a part of the semen.
Spermatozoa are produced in the testicles and are stored in the seminal
vesicles. A normal sperm count is 50-200 per cubic centimetre of
ejaculate, out of which 80% should be mobile or moving.

NOTE 1: Flesh eating disease or “necrotizing fascites” is caused by group A
streptococcus bacteria. There is high temperature, sore throat and
human tissues are destroyed at the rate of 3 cms per hour. Death is
caused within 18 hours if surgery is not done in time. In conventional
and homeopathic medical science, no oral medicine has been invented
to treat this disease so far. However, Streptococcinum 200c may act as
an anti-febrile for quick action.
NOTE 2: Eczema, psoriasis, acne, hives, itching, shingles and other skin

to the functions of the body organs as well as the toxin levels carried
by the blood and an imbalance of the immune function.

SPINE 625

Pain in the lower back is the most common of all pain complaints. It is a medical fact that once discs get injured, they seldom heal. Homeopathic treatment has succeeded in several cases . In order to understand the problem, it maybe understood that the spine is the weakest but the most important part of the body. It is made up of a column of bones that are called vertebrae. One on top of the other, they cover and protect the spinal cord. The spinal cord is a part of the nervous system attached to the brain that controls all the body functions. In between each vertebra is a disc which is made up of a jelly-like substance known as the nucleus. Nucleus is covered with many strong outer layers called annuals. The discs function as shock absorbers to protect the bones and surrounding nerves. Unlike other organs of the body, the discs do not have blood vessels to nourish them. Discs depend upon fluids rich with oxygen and nutrients passing back and forth from the bones above and below them. The fluid exchange depends upon the difference of pressure between the inside of the discs and blood vessels in the bones around them. When the pressure drops inside the disc, fluids and nutrients rush in. This is why all disc nutrients and regeneration takes place while lying down when pressure is taken off the discs. Wear and tear of the disc takes place greater than its ability to heal and regenerate. With advancement of age, the annual layers become weaker, causing injuries including repeated scarring. This weakens the annuals which

This internal damage of the disc can cause backache, sciatica, tingling along the nerves and loss of sensation in the skin. Following repeated injury, discs dry out, scar and degenerate over time thus losing their shock absorbing properties, and pressure is exerted over bones and joints leading to arthritis.

How bacterium attacks the stomach
The discovery of Helicobacter pylori, a bacterium commonly found in human stomach changed how doctors think about ulcers. The bacterium may also provide clues in hu-man migration patterns.
How the bacterium operates in the stomach
The worm-like H. pylori bacterium enters the system through the mouth and moves to the stomach, where it thrives. There, its chemical system neutralizes stomach acid and its hair-like flagella allow it to swim down into the mucous layer next to the stomach lining, above. It attaches itself to the cells of the lining and causes inflammation. A small percent-age of people with the bacterium develop ulcers.

STRESS
Many consultations with homeopaths are stress related. Stress is caused by higher levels of “cortisone” the body's main stress hormone. The human body is able to deal with stress for a short period of time before some symptoms appear. These should be treated with the indicated remedy. High levels of stress can cause insomnia, migraine, ulcers, fibromyalgia , immune system deficiency, hypertension, heart attack, stroke, depression, chronic fatigue syndrome and irritability. Along with the treatment described below, the stress can be reduced by the following ways:

chapters.title: Section 28 (Pages 676-700)
chapters.content:
648 STRESS

1. Add more fun to your life - do things you enjoy and enjoy what you do.
Persue a hobby. Gardening is a soothing exercise. Go on a vacation.
2. Get enough sleep and rest - your body should recharge and discharge
tensions.
3. Laugh often. Laughter is a great tension breaker and it enhances the immune
system. Rent a funny movie, read a funny book or TV show that makes
you laugh and keep it on hand for stress emergencies. Watch a comedy
movie.
4. Regular exercise is a great way to relieve tension, increase energy and
improve the mood. Find an activity you like and do it often. Going for a
walk clears the mind.
5. Love more - learn to use things and to love people, instead of the other
way around. Helping others through voluntary work takes attention away
from anxieties.
6. Eliminate self pity - you may get sympathy for a while, but soon you will
get avoided.
7. Develop a meaningful relationship. It is important to have good friends in
whom you can confide and find support. It is also important to be a true
friend. Talk to such friends.
8. Alter behaviors and attitudes - when ideas or views are not serving you
well - change them. Learn to respond to situations, not react. Compromise.
9. Learn relaxation techniques like meditation, yoga, etc. to experience inner
peace.
10. Express your feelings. Do not suppress your emotions as it can create
stress, pain and illness.
11. Nicotine, alcohol, caffein, sugar and refined carbohydrates should all be
eliminated from consumption. These substances rob the body of stress
fighting vitamins B and C, potassium, zinc and magnesium.
Ashwagandha Q (tds), : A mixture of these two remedies mixed in
Ginseng Q (tds) equal parts and 10 drops a dose, thrice daily
reduces stress by helping adrenal glands to
function properly. Adrenal glands are the main
glands responsible for dealing with stress. The
mixture also gives energy to the body,
increases mental and physical performance,
reduces fatigue and increases resistance to

Hypericum Q (tds) : 15 drops a dose, 3 times a day gives good
STESS—STUDY 649

THYROID GLAND
Thyroid gland is situated just below the larynx and just above the windpipe.
Thyroid disease either under production (hypothyroidism) or over production (hyperthyroidism) of hormones is often hereditary and is on account of a defective immune system, stress or changing hormone levels.

Three steps control the way your thyroid gland functions:
1. First, hormone released from your hypothalamus travels to your pituitary gland (see diagram). This hormone signals the pituitary gland to release another hormone. Thyroid
Stimulating Hormone (TSH).
2. Second, TSH travels from your pituitary gland to your thyroid gland. TSH triggers your thyroid gland to make the hormones thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronne (T3).
3. Third, thyroid hormones T4 and T3 are release from your thyroid gland into your bloodstream. T4 and T3 travel throughout your body and regulate the rate at which many different organ systems work.
Hypothyroidism results when your thyroid gland is underactive—it does not produce enough thyroid hormones for your body to function at the right level. Some of the symptoms of hypothyroidism include fatigue, weight gain and intolerance to cold. Treating hypothyroidism is simple. Medication can replace the thyroid hormones your body is missing.

A lack of sufficient production makes the body use energy slower and it results in easy weight gain, tiredness, forgetfulness, dry coarse hair and skin, heavy menstruation and constipation. It can cause cholesterol levels to rise or trigger depression.
Over-production makes the body use the energy faster and causes nervousness, irritability, bulging eyes, scanty menses, diarrhea and warm moist palms. It can cause heart rhythm irregularities and osteoporosis.
Goitre or swollen thyroid gland can occur in both the forms of the disease.

NOTE: Thyroid problems can somewhat be determined by self examination

1. Exact problem can only be found out by clinical laboratory tests under
the supervision of a endocrinologist.
2. Under a hand mirror, focus on the area of the neck just below the Adam’s
apple and immediately above the collar bone, tipping the head back.
Take a drink of water and swallow. Check for any protrusions on the
neck while swallowing. If there are any bulges, there maybe an enlarged
thyroid gland or a thyroid nodule.
3. A malfunctioning thyroid can be identified through a simple TSH
(thyroid stimulating hormone) blood test that indicates if the hormone
level is too high or too low.
4. In the most common surgery for thyroid cancer, complete thyroid gland
is removed and it is followed by giving radioactive iodine to the patient.
Any remaining cancer tissue absorbs iodine and the radioactive
substance destroys the cancer cells.

T3-Tri-iodothyromine.

TSH-Thyroid stimulating hormone (normal range 0.30-4.70)
T4 is connected with hypothyroidism.

TIPS TO BOOST ENERGY AND DECREASE FEELING OF FATIGUE

1. Including more fruits and vegetables than grain products in a meal.
2. Eat breakfast within 2 hours of waking up.
3. If you consume coffee, carbonated drinks or excessive sweets or salty foods,
drink extra water to avoid dehydration which causes fatigue.
4. Allow three hours for digestion of a large meals and an hour for a light meal
or snack.
5. Emphasis should be on carbohydrate rich foods, which are the best source of
energy. Fruits, vegetables, bread, pasta, rice or cereals are such foods.
6. Avoid foods high in fats such as gravy, fries and greasy foods as they take a
long time to digest.
7. Drink about 8 glasses of water per day.

TUMORS
(SEE ALSO ‘CANCER’)

Normal cells reproduce themselves throughout life but in an orderly and controlled manner. Normal growth occurs, worn out tissues are replaced and wounds heal. When cells grow out of control and form a mass, the mass is called tumor. Some tumors grow and enlarge only at the site where they began and these are benign tumors. Other tumors not only enlarge locally but have the potential to invade and destroy the normal tissues around and to spread to the distant parts of the body. Such tumors are called malignant or cancerous.
Distant spread of a cancer occurs when malignant cells detach themselves from the original (primary) tumor, are carried to other parts of the body through blood or lymphatic vessels and establish themselves at the new site as a cancer.
A tumor that has spread in this way is said to have metastasized and the secondary tumor or (tumors) is called metastasis. However, not all the localised growths are benign and not all the growths occuring at different sites are malignant. Genes are the blue prints that tell a cell when to divide and when to die. Often when a gene turns bad, it triggers uncontrolled growth, but genes called tumor suppressors step in to stop it. It is when these tumor suppressors also turn bad, that the tumor develops.
