Acidum fluor. (tds) : In all cases of varicose of legs, specially old
standing cases. Veins in legs tending to
ulceration. Burning.
Aesculus hip. 3x (tds) : Its use reduces pain and swelling.

Dilated vessels around umbilicus
Dialated veins at lower (caput medusae)
end of esophagus

Dilated hemorrhoids
VARICOSE VEINS—VERTIGO 719

Allium cepa (tds) : Varicose veins after cesarean section.
Ambra grisea (tds) : Varicose veins of left leg, very painful.
Calcarea fluor. 6x (tds) : Varicose veins are knitted in hard lumps, in
chronic cases.
Formica rufa 3x (tds) : If there is debility on account of varicose veins.
Hamamelis 1x (tds) : Excessive pain; when applied externally causes
the vessels to shrink. Use externally for
varicose ulcers. It is almost specific in all cases.
Hippozaeninum (tds) : Scrofulous swelling of the veins with formation
of pus.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : In cases of varicocele and varicose veins when
constitution and symptoms of this remedy are
present. Varicose veins during pregnancy.
Pyrogenium 200 (hs) : Ulceration of the varicose veins with very fetid
Repeat every 3rd day discharge and pain.
Vipera (tds) : The patient has to keep the legs elevated for
fear of bursting of veins while keeping them
hanging.

VERTIGO
Acidum phos. 1x (tds) : Vertigo in the evening when walking or
standing. Stumbles easily and makes misteps.
Aconitum nap. (tds) : Vertigo on rising.
Agaricus mus. (tds) : Vertigo from sunlight and on looking at passing
cars and other vehicles. Sensation of coldness
in the head with a desire to cover it warmly.
Ambra grisea (tds), : Vertigo of old people, due to any cause. Has
Bellis per. (tds) to lie down to avoid vertigo.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Long standing vertigo is cured by the use of
this remedy specially when the objects whirl
about when walking.
Belladonna (tds) : Vertigo on stooping or when rising from a seat.
Borax (tds) : Vertigo while descending.
720 VERTIGO—VISION

Bryonia alba (tds) : Vertigo on moving the head or from rising from
bed.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Vertigo from ascending.
Cocculus ind. (tds) : Vertigo on watching a hockey match or from
loss of sleep or rising from bed.
Conium mac. (qid) : Vertigo on turning the head sidewise or turning
in bed or looking around sidewise or when
lying.
Digitalis (tds) : It is very efficacious in several very severe
cases of vertigo. It is specially indicated when
the pulse is very slow.
Ferrum phos. (tds) : Vertigo due to anemia or loss of blood.
Gratiola off. (tds) : Vertigo during and after meals.
Lachesis (bd) : Vertigo on rising from the bed in the morning
and after sleep.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Vertigo on studying.
Nux vomica (tds) : Vertigo from stooping and after eating, or from
odor of flowers, or from loss of sleep or from
walking or with fainting or with staggering.
Phosphorus (od) : It displays great curative powers in every
imaginable case of vertigo. Vertigo on looking
down and from odor of flowers.
Pulsatilla nig. (tds) : Vertigo on looking up or from suppressed
menses.
Sepia (tds) : Vertigo from suppressed menses.
Theridion (tds) : Vertigo on least noise and on closing eyes.
Vanadium (tds) : Vertigo an account of lack of oxygen in blood
and degenerative conditions of liver and
arteries.

VISION
In all cases of eye trouble, it is advisable that the eyes are examined by an efficient and reputed eye specialist. When no organic defect is found in the eyes by them and yet the patient has some symptoms of the eyes, one or more of the following remedies may be tried according to the symptoms:
VISION—VITAL FORCE 721

Aconitum nap. (tds), : Patient becomes almost blind during night
Belladonna (tds) but is okay during the day.
Aurum met. (tds) : Lower or upper half is invisible.
Belladonna (tds) : Flashes before the eyes.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Left or right half not visible.
Carboneum sulph. (tds) : Sensation of a cobweb before the eyes.
Ferrum met. (tds) : The patient can see equally during the day and
night.
Hyoscyamus nig. (tds) : Red spots before the eyes.
Lithium carb. (tds) : Right half of an image is invisible.
Lycopodium (tds) : Night blindness with black spots before the
eyes.
Phosphorus 200 (hs) : Blindness on account of lightening. Give four
Repeat after 1 week doses in a month after a gap of a week between
each dose. If there is no improvement at
all,consult an eye specialist.It is also used for
color blindness.
Pilocarpus (tds) : It improves far sightedness, specially when
there appears to be a mist before the eyes.
Ruta (tds) : Eyes are fatigued easily on reading or watching
TV.
Sepia (tds) : Dimness of vision after coition.
Sulphur (od) : Black spots before the eyes. Patient’s eyes
resemble the eyes of an owl, who can see
during the night but not during the day. Mist
before the eyes.

VITAL FORCE
Armoracia sat. (tds) : Use thrice daily for raising the vital force for
quite sometime.
Carbo veg. (tds) : An acute disease has greatly depleted the
patients. Patient is incapable of any movement
and his fingers become blue. Cold, copious
722 VITAL FORCE—VOICE - LOSS

sweats, cold breath, cold tongue and cold body
as if there is no life in it. Loss of voice. Carbo
veg. saves life where vital force is nearly
exhausted.
Coca Q (tds) : Exhausted nervous system. Loss of voice. 5-6 drops, three times a day.
Cochlearia arm. Q (tds) : Raises the vital forces. Useful in enfeebled
states of stomach; causes copious production
of urine.
Lobelia purp. 6 (tds) : All the vital forces are weak. Nervous
prostration. Intense feeling of chill without
shivering. Tongue, heart and lungs feel
paralysed. Use it in lower potencies.
Picricum acidum (tds) : Vital force is weakened. There is excessive and
persistent tired feeling all over the body.Want
of will power. Weakness of mind.
Silicea 6x (tds) : It strengthens the vital force and cures very
deep seated diseases. Here also the patient feels
cold and likes to keep his head covered always.

VOICE - LOSS
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Loss of voice on account of excessive heating
of the body or after over-use of the voice.
Argentum met. (tds) : Loss of voice from too much singing or
shouting. Voice breaks during singing.
Hoarseness may result from much singing and
shouting. Total loss of voice in professional
singers.
Aurum met. 1M (hs) : Sudden loss of voice in singers or public
speakers after lengthy speaking. It also cures
hoarseness in such cases.
Borax 1x (hs) : A piece of Borax 1x (sodium borate) of the
size of a pea, dissolved slowly in the mouth,
acts magically in restoring the voice in case of
sudden hoareness brought on by cold. For an
hour or so, it renders the voice clear and silvery.

chapters.title: Section 31 (Pages 751-775)
chapters.content:
VOICE - LOSS—VOMITING 723

Carbo veg. (tds) : Loss of voice with hoarseness after a
debilitating disease.
Causticum (tds) : It is worth trying for loss of voice whether from
psychological or inflammatory causes, when
there are no other symptoms for accurate
prescription. Loss of voice due to a defect in
the larynx
Coca Q, : When a singer or a public speaker experiences
5-6 drops every ½ hour loss of voice during singing or speaking, give
5-6 drops every half an hour, about two hours
before the expected demand on the voice.
Croton tig. (tds) : There is complete loss of voice from drinking
cold water or cold beverages, when over-heated.
Ferrum pic. (tds) : Voice fails after public speaking or singing.
Phosphorus (bd) : Loss of voice with laryngitis and constant
hawking.
Populus candicans Q (tds) : It is a remarkable voice restorer, restores
almost instantly. It removes hoarseness and
dryness of the larynx and pharynx, rawness and
soreness of the throat and tones up the voice.

VOMITING
Aethusa cyn. (tds) : Vomiting after drinking milk.
Amygdalus per. Q (tds) : Very useful in all kinds of nausea and vomiting
or morning sickness or vomiting in pregnancy.
Children do not digest any kind of food which
is vomited out.
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Vomiting after eating or drinking due to
indigestion. After nursing, the child vomits
milk in curds, refuses to nurse afterwards and
is very cross.
Apocynum can. Q (bd) : Excessive vomiting. Nausea with drowsiness.
Food and water is immediately ejected. Dull,
sinking feeling in the stomach. Oppression in
724 VOMITING

epigastrium and chest with difficulty in
breathing.
Apomorphinum Q (hs) : The chief power of this remedy is that it
produces vomiting. 25 drops in a little water
will cause full vomiting in 5-15 minutes.It is
used when some poison has been swallowed
and is still lying in the stomach.
Aquilegia vulg. (tds) : Vomiting after menopause or hysterical
vomiting.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Vomiting of all kinds of foods and drinks due
to acidity, specially after eating and drinking.
Vomiting maybe easy and voilent. Diarrhea
may occur with vomiting.
Belladonna (tds) : Incessant, uncontrollable vomiting.
Carbolicum acidum (tds) : Constant belching, nausea and vomiting of
dark olive green matter. Vomiting due to a
cancer in esophagus or stomach.
Cina (tds) : Vomiting with worm symptoms.
Cocculus ind. (tds) : Vomiting during travelling by bus or car.
Crotalus hor. (tds) : Vomiting after menstruation.
Euphrasia (tds), : Clearing throat of mucus in the morning causes
Bryonia alba (tds) vomiting.
Ferrum met. (tds) : Vomiting immediately after eating.
Geraninum (tds) : Relieves vomiting in gastric ulcers. Give half
dram dose, thrice daily in a little water.
Hydrophobinum (tds) : Vomiting at the sight of running water.
Ipecacuanha (qid) : Good for all kinds of vomiting.
Iris vers. (tds) : It is a good remedy for the habitual vomiting
of babies.
Kalium bich. (tds) : Vomiting after drinking beer.
Nux vomica (tds) : Vomiting in the morning after drinking whisky
at night.
Phosphorus (tds) : Vomiting after an operation.
Plumbum met. (tds) : Continuous and violent vomiting of food or of
greenish or yellowish or blackish matter with
VOMITING—VULVA 725

violent pains in the stomach and abdomen.
Vomiting of bile or blood. Vomiting of fecal
matter. Colic, constipation.
Pyrogenium (tds) : Coffee ground color of vomit.
Symphoricarpus 200 (bd) : This is a routine remedy for cure of persistant
vomiting of pregnancy and nausea during
menstruation. Nausea is worse by motion.
Sepia (tds), : Vomiting during pregnancy.
Colchicum autum. (tds)
Stannum met. (tds) : Smell of cooking food causes vomiting.
Sensation of emptiness in the stomach.
Staphysagria (tds) : Vomiting due to insults inflicted upon her.
Thyreoidinum 3x (tds) : Vomiting of pregnancy. Give a dose early in
the morning before the patient gets up.
Valeriana (tds) : Vomiting due to anger in nursing women. Child
vomits curdled milk after nursing.
Veratrum alb. (tds) : Thirst for cold water which is vomited out as
soon as it is swallowed. There is violent
retching with cold perspiration on the forehead
during and before vomiting.

VULVA
Bromium (tds), : Emission of flatus from the vulva.
Lac can. (tds),
Lycopodium (tds)
Copaiva off. (tds) : Inflammation of vulva with itching.
Eupionum (tds) : Sore pain between labia during urination.
Swelling of labia. Pruritus vulva.
Kalium iod. (tds), : Burning of vulva.
Sanguinaria (tds)
Plumbum met. (tds) : Eczema of vulva.
Urtica urens (tds) : Herpes labialis, burning and itching.
726 VULVODYNIA—WALKING

VULVODYNIA
Vulvodynia is the pain of the vulva which is so uncomfortable that woman cannot enjoy sex and her refusal to do so often ends in the breaking of her relationship with her husband. It plagues millions of women and is not understood properly. Many assume from the burning and itching that it is a yeast infection although there is no yeast present. The following remedies have given wonderful results:
Apis mel. (tds) : Swelling of the vulva with stinging pains worse
by heat and touch.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Pain with burning, which is relieved by
application of warm water.
Sepia (tds) : Violent stitching pain travels up from vulva to
vagina and is worse from washing and cold,
and better by pressure and warmth of the bed.
Aversion to coition as the pain eclipses desire.
Sulphur (od) : Burning and itching worse by the heat of the
bed, washing and bathing. Better by drawing
the legs up.

WALKING
Acidum phos. (tds), : Walks slowly without a reason and easily
Gelsemium (tds) makes missteps and stumbles.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Walking unsteady and staggering when not
noticed.
Baryta carb. (tds), : Child is slow to learn walking.
Calcarea carb. (tds),
Calcarea phos. (tds)
Causticum (tds) : Patient is slow in learning to walk. Unsteady
walking and easy falling.
Coffea cruda (tds), : Walks fast and quickly without any reason.
Sepia (tds)
Conium mac. (tds) : Sudden loss of strength when walking.
Crotalus hor. (tds) : Walks on tip toes.
WALKING—WARS 727

Heloderma (tds) : When walking, lifts feet higher than usual and
brings them down with a thud.
Kalium phos. (tds), : Walks half-consciously in sleep.
Silicea (tds)
Lacticum acidum (tds) : When walking, trembles all over.
Lac can. (tds) : When walking, seems to be walking in air.
Lachesis 200 (hs) : Knees knock against each other while walking.
Repeat after a week
Lathyrus sat. (tds) : When walking, heels do not touch the ground.
Lathyrus sat. (tds), : Must stoop when walking.
Mezereum (tds)
Magnesium carb. (tds) : Suddenly falls to the ground while walking.
Manganum acet. (tds) : Cannot walk backwards without falling
forward. Walks stooping forward. Peculiar
slapping gait. Walks on metacarpo-phalangeal
joints. Walks on toes.
Medorrhinum 200 (hs) : When walking legs feel heavy like lead. Cannot
Repeat after a week walk on soles. Walk on the heels.
Nux vomica (tds) : Drags feet while walking.
Oxytropis (tds) : Staggering gait. Walks backwards.
Silicea (tds) : Scrofulous, rachitic children with a large
abdomen. Slow in walking, night walking,gets
up while asleep.
Thuja occ. (tds) : Legs feel heavy, as if made of wood or glass.

WARS
Aconitum nap. (tds) : A soldier becomes nervous on taking part in a
war for fear of death or other horrors of war
and is reluctant to fight. A dose of this remedy
will remove his fears and nervousness.
Argentum nit. (tds) : By the use of this remedy, anxiety on account
of air raids is diminished.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Any person who has been too close to the site
728 WARS

of a bomb explosion and is not hurt, but feels
fear and anxiety, will be comforted by a dose
of this remedy.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Sleeplessness due to fear of air raids is cured
by this remedy.
Borax 3x (tds) : Voilent fright from the sound of a firing gun,
even at a distance.
Convallaria maj. Q (bd) : Palpitations and impending heart failure of the
aged from a sudden explosion of a bomb.
Extremely rapid and irregular pulse.
Hypericum Q (bd) : For healing the wounds produced by gun shots
and after the lead has been take out surgically,
apply externally and take orally for injuries of
the nerves.
Ignatia amara (tds) : Fear and anxiety of air raids is removed by the
use of this remedy.
Iodium Q (bd) : It is a powerful and harmless remedy to keep
gun shot wounds clean and disinfected when
used locally.
Kalium iod. 1x (tds) : It protects the thyroid gland in case of an
accidental release of radioactivity from the
nuclear stations. People living near, in about a
10 kilometre radius of nuclear generating
plants, should keep such tablets handy in their
houses and take them as soon as possible, after
the radiation leak, in order to avoid permanent
damage to their thyroid gland and they should
move to a far off place quickly.
Phosphorus (od), : Removes bad effects of the radiations on acco-Strontium carb. (tds) unt of an atom bomb explosion.
Symphytum off. Q (tds), : When the bones have been pierced by gun
Trillium pend. Q (tds) shots which have been removed surgically, take
Symphytum Q internally and apply Trillium
pend. Q externally to arrest bleeding.
Thallium (tds) : Loss of hair due to an atom bomb explosion.
WARTS 729

WARTS
(PAPILLOMA)

Acidum phos. (tds), : Black warts.
Sabina (tds)
Acidum salicylic. 3X (tds) : Itchy and pustular warts. Scratching gives
some relief.
Anacardium ori. (tds), : Warts on the palms of the hand.
Dulcamara (tds),
Natrium mur. (tds)
Anagallis 1x (tds) : It possess power of softening flesh and
destroying warts.
Antimonium crud. (tds) : Warts on soles, palms and neck. Warts soft
and smooth.
Antimonium tart. (tds) : Warts on glans penis.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Warts on the right hand.
Arsenicum alb. (tds), : Warts on the back of the hand.
Natrium carb. (tds)
Aurum mur. (tds) : Warts on the tongue and genitals.
Calcarea calcinata 3x (tds) : It is a remedy for all kinds of warts.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Red warts on the fingers.Warts on face and
hands.
Calcarea fluor. 12x (tds) : Hard wart or a mole on the scalp.
Cannabis ind. (tds), : Warts situated on the prepuce.
Acidum phos. (tds)
Carbo animalis (tds) : Warts on hands and face of old people.
Castor equi (tds) : Warts on breasts.
Castoreum (tds) : Warts on forehead.
Causticum (tds) : Warts on finger tips, right index finger, on the
face, eyelids and in or outside the nose.
Burning and bleeding easily. Maybe situated
all over the body.
Dulcamara (tds) : Warts on the lower eyelid of the eyes. Large
smooth warts on the palms.
730 WARTS—WATER

Ferrum met. (tds), : Warts on the left hand.
Psorinum (tds)
Ficus carica (tds) : The fresh milky juice obtained by breaking the (Fig) stalk when applied externally on warts causes
their disappearance.
Kalium crb. (tds) : Warts on the fingers.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Warts on forearms.
Natrium mur. (tds) : Warts on palms.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Red warts on the whole body. General remedy
for warts specially when fingers and toes are
affected.
Nitricum acidum (tds) : Warts are like cauliflowers on lips or anywhere;
hard, having cracks, sometimes emitting a fetid
fluid. Warts on genitals. Warts bleed on
washing.
Ruta (tds) : Warts on the inside of hands.
Sarsaparilla (tds) : Warts around joints of fingers.
Sepia (tds) : Warts situated on the whole body.
Thuja occ. 1M (hs) : Warts on the anus, thumb, sides of the fingers
Repeat after a week and the left index finger. Warts in crops,
sometimes oozing moisture or blood.Warts on
genitals and anal surfaces.
NOTE: A mixture of Thuja Q, Anagallis Q and Ficus carica Q in equal parts is
mixed in a little amount of vaseline to make a paste. It can be applied
locally on the wart, along with dispensing of the oral remedy.

WATER
Ammonium carb. (tds) : Great aversion to water. Cannot bear to touch
it.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Aversion to water and washing as it aggravates
ailments. Affections caused by working in
water like those of washermen or
washerwomen.
Ferrum met. (tds) : Sight of flowing water causes vertigo.
WATER—WEAKNESS 731

Hydrophobinum (tds) : Dread of flowing water.
Hyoscyamus nig. (tds) : Dislikes water as he cannot swallow liquids.
Laurocerasus 1c (tds) : On drinking water or other liquids, it rolls
audibly through the esophagus and intestines.
Natrium sulph. (tds) : Complaints due to water, like living in damp
basements or near rivers, lakes and sea.
Symptoms worse in rainy weather. Cannot eat
any seafood like fish or even plants growing
near water.
Sepia (tds) : It is called washerwomen’s remedy, because
the ailments worsen due to laundry work.
Sulphur (od) : Dislikes water. Aversion to being washed.
NOTE 1: An average person needs about 8 glasses of water per day in summer
and half this amount in winter. Water can suppress appetite, help reduce
fat deposits, rid the body of harmful salts, help kidney flush toxins
from the body, regulate body temperature, prevent constipation and
keep the skin hydrated and glowing. It is one of the most important
catalysts in losing weight and keeping it off.
NOTE 2: Every other substance becomes heavier, smaller and denser when it
changes from liquid to solid, but water expands and becomes lighter,
so much so that ice floats. Water is the only substance on earth that
occurs naturally in 3 states of matter - liquid, solid and gas.

NOTE 3: Water is required by the body to moisten all the tissues and cells.

WEAKNESS (DEBILITY)
Aceticum acidum (tds) : Prostration after surgery and use of anesthesia.
Acidum mur. 3x (tds) : Debility during low and septic fevers.
Involuntary stools while passing urine.
Acidum phos. Q (bd) : 5 drops of it in a tumblerful of water as a
beverage along with meals, for debility by loss
of vital fluids, sexual excesses and
disappointed love. Debility both sexual and
physical, with depressing emotions.
Aletris far. (tds) : Debility due to prolapse of uterus.
732 WEAKNESS

Argentum nit. (tds) : Debility of calves. Walks and stands
unsteadily.
Arnica mont. (tds) : Muscular fatigue due to over-exertion or due
to injuries.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Debility resulting from over-taxing the
muscular system by exercise, etc.
Arsenicum iod. 3x (tds) : General weakness. Tendency to faint. Loss of
appetite. Thrice daily after food, with an
interval of a day or two after a week of its use.
Avena sativa Q (bd) : Debility after exhausting diseases.
Cadmium sulph. (tds) : Exhaustion of mind and body. Declination to
work after chronic post-influenzal states.
Extreme prostration in low forms of diseases.
Calcarea carb. (tds) : Debility in fat children.
Calcarea phos. 6x (tds) : Debility after acute diseases, over-work, worry
or depressing emotions.
Carbo veg. (tds) : Debility without fever, with blueness and
coldness. A lowered vital power from loss of
fluids or after drugging. Debility in old people
due to disintegration and imperfect oxidation.
China off. 1M (hs) : After profuse bleeding during delivery, a dose
of it will help recover the strength of the
patient.
China off. 1x, (tds), : From loss of blood or other animal fluids
Curare (tds) like semen or leucorrhea.
Cinchona rub. Q (bd) : Nervously run down women are benefitted by
the use of this remedy.
Colchicum autum. (tds) : Prostration and feeling of internal coldness as
an effect of hard study or night watching. A
peculiar symptom of this remedy is that the
patient complains of prostration and weakness,
trouble though he looks well.
Conium mac. (tds) : General debility of body and mind - most felt
in the morning while in bed. Feeling as if
bruised by blows. Gout, trembling and sudden
WEAKNESS 733

loss of strength while walking.
Conium mac. (tds), : Great debility in the morning in bed. Debility
Lycopodium (tds), of aged people.
Baryta mur. (tds),
Natrium mur. (tds)
Curare (tds), : Debility of the aged people.
Ambra grisea (tds),
Baryta mur. (tds)
Ferrum phos. 6x (qid) : Debility due to anemia. Tired feeling in the
brain. Depression.
Ginseng (tds) : Removes weakness and produces sense of
general well being.
Hamamelis Q (bd) : Weakness from loss of blood from open and
painful wounds.
Helonias (tds) : Debility, dragging in sacrum and pelvis.
Iodium (tds) : Great unaccountable sense of debility. Little
effort induces perspiration. Loss of breath on
going upstairs. Feels better for the time being,
during eating.
Kalium carb. (tds) : Muscular debility combined with weakened
condition of the nerves. This makes him very
sensitive. He is easily frightened, shrieks about
imaginary appearances, cannot bear to be
touched and startles when touched.
Kalium phos. 6x (tds) : Debility from mental strain.
Lathyrus sat. (tds) : Debility after influenza and other diseases.
Lecithinum 3x (tds) : Acts as a tonic during convalescence and in
anemia. Removes symptoms of general break
down and tiredness. Improves health.
Natrium carb. (tds) : Debility due to summer heat.
Natrium mur. 200 (od) : Weakness of the spine. Mental and physical
debility. Weakness of the limbs like half
paralysed extremities. Physical and mental
labor is prostrating. Most weakness is felt in
the morning.
Natrium sal. (tds) : One of the best remedies for the prostrating
after-effects of influenza.
734 WEAKNESS —WEATHER

Psorinum (od) : Debility after acute diseases such as typhoid.
Chilliness. Desire to lie down.
Selenium met. (tds) : Mental and physical weakness in old age.
Debility due to summer heat and after
exhausting diseases. Weakness after exercise
and in hot weather. Strength rises as the sun
sinks.
Silicea (tds) : Prostration of mind and body. Want of grit or
grit all gone. It builds up such persons, raises
spirits, revives hopes and weakness, depression
gives way to the feeling of returning strength
and health. Debility of thin, rickety children.
Strophanthus (tds) : Severe prostration from hemorrhage after
operation and acute diseases.
Syphilinum 1M (hs) : Weakness and all other symptoms, pain, etc.
are worse from darkness to daylight, sunset to
sunrise, decrease and increase gradually. Utter
prostration and debility in the morning.
Thyreoidinum 2x (tds) : Weakness, sensation of faintness and nausea.
Sensitive to cold. Weakness after acute
diseases. Easy fatigue, weak pulse, palpita-tions, cold hands and feet, chilliness and low
blood pressure. Specially indicated in patients
with thyroid troubles.
Veratrum alb. (tds) : Cardiac and general muscular depression and
weakness. A good heart tonic.

WEATHER

COLD WEATHER

Antimonium sulph. (tds) : Winter cough with soreness all over the body.
Argentum nit. (tds) : Cannot withstand hot weather and very cold
weather.
Arsenicum alb. (tds) : Skin diseases becomes worse during winter.
Aurum met. (tds) : All complaints worse in cold weather and when
getting cold. Many complaints come only in

NOTE: My own experience shows that wrinkles can be prevented to a great extent
by using the following tips:
1. Massaging the face with an upward motion from the cheeks to the
forehead.
2. Vitamin E mixed with any oil should be used for the massage.
3. Onion juice mixed with honey is an excellent anti-wrinkle paste.
Before application, the face should be washed with soap and water,
and dried.
4. Plenty of rest and sleep helps to keep the looks young and fresh.
5. Scientists have long known that sunlight can cause skin to wrinkle
and turn leathery. Skin damage is caused by ultra-violet solar rays
which are absorbed by urocanic acid, a natural molecule, made by
the outer most skin cells. Sun rays chemically change this molecule
making it free of oxygen thus degrading collagen and elastin, which
are the major molecules that make the skin. Elasticity of the skin is
reduced making a person look older than he is.
6. Bananas have anti-wrinkle properties apart from making the skin
soft and supple. Mash a quarter of banana into a creamy paste and
apply it on the face. Leave it for about 20 minutes and then rinse the
face alternately with warm and cold water to boost the blood
circulation. Instant softening of the wrinkles and lines will not be
able to escape notice.

NOTE : Here are some tips as how to feel mentally young and psychologically
fit in senior years:
1. Maintain regularity in life by getting up early in the morning,
taking a bath regularly and eating at regular intervals. Break the
boredom by eating out at a reputed restaurant once in a while.
2. Exercise the brain by reading or listening to books on subjects
which were liked in the younger years. Keep busy.

748 YOUTHFUL LOOKS

3. Keep company of stimulating and agreeing younger companions.
This can have positive effects on mental sharpness and happiness.
4. Do not start feeling lonely, bored or unhappy. These feeling make
one sick. Weather permitting, going out for a short walk or
watching a movie, breaks such feelings.
5. Cosmetic laser surgery can also bring about youthful looks by
removing bags and lines from eyelids,wrinkles and sun damaged
skin of the face, removal of unwanted hair, reshaping of lips, nose,
breasts, buttocks, etc.
6. Body has an enzyme called Telomerase. It is also called
“Immortality enzyme” in layman’s language. It encourages cells
to keep dividing indefinately instead of dying with age. It is said
that it does not turn healthy cells into malignant or cancer cells.
In course of time, homeopathic researchers may develop potentised
telomerase which may prove as an anti-aging agent.
7. Antioxidants slow down the aging process. Vitamins C and E, and
beta-carotenes are primary sources of antioxidants and are
obtained from fruits, nuts, vegetables and polyunsaturated oils.
